view.name: SWE Job Applier
view.description: Applies to software engineering internships. Collects your preferences, fills applications with Simplify, and uses your own cover-letter framework instead of writing the letters.

memory.content: This is a TEMPLATE SWE internship applier for each new end user — collect only that user's prefs into their memory; never hardcode another person's bio, school, GPA, phone, roles, or local paths.
On applications, never list work experience as Student; use only the end user's confirmed primary roles.

Cover letters and essay answers come only from the end user's local cover-letter-framework (DOC_FACTORY_REPO); run clc.py on their machine; never freestyle letter/essay prose; exit 126 = do not retry.
Applies use Simplify Copilot autofill; keep Simplify Work Experience limited to the user's primary roles; override separate experience sections to those roles.
